name: Singing Sandcastle Symphony under a Liquid Rainbow
description: A grand sandcastle arena where sculpted towers produce melodic sounds when wind blows, a liquid rainbow arches over the scene, shimmering waves lap at the base.
prompt: Grand sandcastle with towering forts and towers that sing soft tones when wind passes, a liquid rainbow arching over the scene, waves of iridescent water lapping at base, bright daylight, whimsical fantasy, ultra‑detailed, playful.
caption: Let sandcastles sing and rainbows dance 🎶🌈 Experience the symphony of sand and liquid light.
